integrity: The proof is a complete character-by-character classification using abelian-cover eigensheaves, Riemann--Roch, Serre duality, and elementary K4 edge-weight combinatorics. Finite enumeration for n=2 through 8 is only a replay check and is not used to justify the general quantifier.
scientific_limitations: The result determines the irregularity, the resulting geometric genus, and the degree-zero local-cohomology deficiency. It does not determine the Albanese map or variety, the full Hodge ring, or the full graded local-cohomology module. Because complete-quadrangle Hirzebruch-Kummer covers are classical, differently phrased older literature remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact irregularity of the second Hirzebruch covers
